artifact_observations.location: Pink grid paper inside plastic pocket
artifact_observations.reasoning: Text on the pink paper appears nonsensical and malformed. Characters are distorted, inconsistent in size and alignment, and do not form readable words. This is a common AI artifact where text generation fails to produce coherent typography.

The metal rings appear slightly fused and lack clear individual definition. Some rings seem to merge into each other or the binding bar, lacking the precise mechanical separation expected in real binders.
The right edge of the binder shows slight warping and inconsistent thickness. The perspective lines don't align perfectly with the rest of the object, suggesting minor geometric instability.
The grid lines on the pink paper show slight inconsistencies in spacing and straightness. Some lines appear to fade or distort unnaturally, particularly near the drawn diagrams.

selected_experts.reason: Primary classification verification to confirm the object is indeed a binder and not a similar folder type
Audit the structural integrity and connectivity of the metal rings to detect fusion or missing components
Analyze the gibberish text artifacts on the inserted paper for character-level coherence and readability issues
Verify 3D structural consistency of the open binder, especially the relationship between covers and ring mechanism
Holistic quality assessment to catch any additional subtle artifacts or texture inconsistencies

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay special attention to the text artifacts on the pink paper - this is likely the most significant AI indicator. Also examine whether the ring mechanism shows proper mechanical separation or if rings are fused together. The Router may have underestimated the severity of the text gibberish artifact.
